_description: Each group has its own message file: data/messages/{groupId}.json
Keeping messages in separate files prevents loading all chat history
into memory when only group metadata is needed.
type: 'image'  – image upload; fileUrl points to /uploads/<filename>
The UI renders an tag for inline preview.
type: 'file'   – generic file upload; fileUrl used for download link.
If mime type is application/pdf the browser opens it natively.
type: 'system' – server-generated (join/leave events). senderId is null.
deletedAt: soft-delete timestamp. If set, UI shows 'Message deleted'.
The record is kept to preserve reply threading references.
replyToId: optional FK to a parent message in the same group.
readBy:    array of userIds who have seen the message (for read receipts).
